verdict.rationale: Agora's core-concepts docs describe a publish/subscribe model in which clients publish media streams into channels and play the streams they subscribe to, which implies per-participant selective delivery. The pack never explicitly describes the server-side routing architecture (SFU or relay) or confirms that only subscribed tracks are forwarded. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SFU/relay media routing, confirmation that only subscribed tracks are delivered to each participant, selective subscription APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to

citations.quote: You either directly play the subscribed streams or process incoming data for other purposes such as recording or capturing screenshots.
You can also publish media streams from other sources, such as an online music file or the user’s screen.
In a live streaming channel, users have two client roles: *host* and *audience*.
